what_differs: Meetings decided that WagerTech enters a monthly redeposit budget per deal manually, and on 2026-09-30 removed the budget-entry layer so allocations sit directly under the monthly budget. No Jira ticket defines these objects; WAGR-464 still lists 'Where does the budget live, and in what unit?' and 'Batch level' as open decisions, and WAGR-108 says the Redeposit object is not ticketed.
suggested_action: Suggestion: record the 2026-09-30 data-model outcome on WAGR-464 (close the 'budget location' and 'batch level' open decisions) and create build stories for the Monthly Redeposit Budget and Redeposit Allocation objects, under a Redeposits epic.
